provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10: the usage policy (archive data and the programmatic APIs under CC0 1.0; attributing the original authors is encouraged; Molecule of the Month art is CC BY 4.0, not used here) and the Web APIs overview (the APIs are rate-limited, no figure: start with "a handful of requests per second", 429 beyond, back off exponentially; shared public IPs reach the limit sooner; static files unrestricted). No RateLimit header seen on a live call. Operations if split: data = https://data.rcsb.org/, search = https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/query (one policy for both on the page).
